preconditions.description: The length of string A must be between 1 and 1,000,000.
The length of string B must be between 1 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in A)
preconditions.description: String A must consist only of the characters '0' and '1'.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in B)
preconditions.description: String B must consist only of the characters '0' and '1'.

postconditions.description: The output must be the result of adding the binary strings A and B.
The output string must not have leading zeros unless it is '0'.
The length of the output string must be at most the length of the longer input string plus one.
